definitions.explanation: Meeting someone again after a period of separation. Carries an emotional nuance of being reunited with someone missed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{再会|さいかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Tears came at the reunion after ten years.

examples.japanese: いつか⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧{再会|さいかい}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}っている→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.english: I hope we can meet again someday.

notes:
Implies an emotional significance to the meeting — not just bumping into someone again, but being genuinely reunited. Often used with ～⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧ (after a gap of...) to emphasize the length of separation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再会|さいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (achieve a reunion)
- {再会|さいかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧ (be happy about a reunion)
- ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再会|さいかい} (moving reunion)
- ～⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再会|さいかい} (reunion after [a period])

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {再会|さいかい}: meeting a person again (emotional, after separation)
- ⟦{再開|さいかい}→再開：05219_saikai⟧: resumption, reopening (restarting an activity or operation — different kanji, same reading)

cross_references.notes: 再開 (さいかい) means resumption/reopening — different kanji, same reading
